BEGIN;

-- Backfill missing task translations from legacy task title/description before dropping columns.
WITH preferred_lang AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM i18n
    WHERE language = 'ru'
    LIMIT 1
),
fallback_lang AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM i18n
    ORDER BY language
    LIMIT 1
),
chosen_lang AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        (SELECT id FROM preferred_lang),
        (SELECT id FROM fallback_lang)
    ) AS id
)
INSERT INTO task_i18n (task_id, i18n_id, title, description)
SELECT
    t.id,
    cl.id,
    t.title,
    t.description
FROM task t
CROSS JOIN chosen_lang cl
WHERE cl.id IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(BTRIM(t.title), '') <> ''
  AND COALESCE(BTRIM(t.description), '') <> ''
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM task_i18n ti
      WHERE ti.task_id = t.id
  );

ALTER TABLE task DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS title;
ALTER TABLE task DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS description;

COMMIT;
